_note: One row per metric in docs/architecture/ATLAS-TARGET-ARCHITECTURE.md. AUTHORED — scripts/metrics-report.mjs reads it and never writes it. A metric whose `check` produces no result is reported `not measurable`, never `passing`: absence of a signal is not a pass. `milestone` is the roadmap milestone at which the check is expected to exist; it is documentation, not logic. `gate` (Phase 7): `hard` = CI fails unless the row reads passing; `trend` = bench-only, a >20% regression against benchmarks/results/protocol-baseline.json opens a report and never blocks; `report` = shown, not gated, with `gateWhy`.

sources.atlas-sync: atlas/tokens.json figmaBound (committed; generated by npm run atlas:sync from the Figma bound-variable harvest)
sources.token-lint: node packages/governance/token-lint.mjs --json over the committed tree (the rules atlas-verify's code.raw-design-values and code.reduced-motion-required report; scripts/lib/token-rules.mjs METRIC_RULES)

metrics.metric: Agent outputs containing CSS, HTML, JSX, or arbitrary markup
metrics.check: runtime/validator > rejects markup in prop values

metrics.metric: Agent outputs containing CSS, HTML, JSX, or markup (agent compliance)
metrics.why: Tier 3, bench-only (DEC-093): the reading is the committed batch in benchmarks/results/protocol-latest (label, date and model in its run.json); claude-sonnet-5-5 through `claude -p` on the subscription (tools, settings and MCP off, empty working directory), fallback-served reps excluded. Passes when no kept rep streams a markup issue (owner decision, session 27: non-op lines are reported as `nonOpReps`, not counted); the vitest row above measures the validator's enforcement instead.

metrics.metric: Rendered nodes mapped to registered components
metrics.check: runtime-demo > every node carries a registered data-atlas-type

metrics.metric: Direct raw color or spacing values accepted by components
metrics.why: Phase 2d: token-lint's colour rules, no-raw-length (strict over packages/ui-web/src; @media widths, em units and the visually-hidden 1px are not lengths) and no-private-var-escape (a --_ var is one semantic alias or an allowlisted, reasoned exception).

metrics.metric: Registered types removed between releases
metrics.why: Phase 4 registryComplete ratchet: the authored-entry count under packages/registry/src may only increase. An entry is an agent-visible type; removal is breaking and goes through an owner decision first.

metrics.metric: Protocol messages passing schema validation
Full conversation replay required for UI interaction
metrics.check: runtime-demo > interaction sends a state delta, not a re-render

metrics.metric: Median protocol size versus equivalent markup
metrics.check: runtime/protocol > payload is at most 30% of rendered markup bytes
metrics.gateWhy: Report-only by decision (DEC-085): the protocol size ratio reads 0.308 against 0.30; a more compact protocol is a separate decision.

metrics.metric: First valid streamed operation
metrics.why: Tier 3, bench-only (DEC-093): the reading is the committed batch in benchmarks/results/protocol-latest (label, date and model in its run.json); claude-sonnet-5-5 through `claude -p` on the subscription (tools, settings and MCP off, empty working directory), fallback-served reps excluded. Measured from process spawn, so it includes CLI startup and time to first token; the reading reflects the transport as much as the protocol. Session 28: the reading is the warm p95 (the first valid op minus the CLI cold start, which `coldStartMs` reports separately); the trend baseline is the warm figure.

metrics.metric: Interactive components with typed event contracts
metrics.why: Measured from the committed registry by scripts/lib/registry-metrics.mjs, the function atlas-verify's design/registry-events runs. An interactive registered type (own on* handler, interaction member on Figma's State axis, or a declared capability) must declare events whose handlers exist in the generated facts. The population is the registered types, so the row carries how many of the components that is.

metrics.metric: User events lost or reordered
metrics.check: runtime-demo > 50 rapid submits keep strictly increasing sequence

metrics.metric: Interactions requiring full-screen regeneration
metrics.check: runtime-demo > patch updates only the addressed subtree

metrics.metric: State acknowledgment latency
Invalid payloads producing a safe render
Unhandled render exceptions
Components with declared fallback behavior
metrics.why: Measured from the committed registry by scripts/lib/registry-metrics.mjs (atlas-verify design/registry-fallback). Every registered type declares a fallback to a registered type, every chain ends at the one terminal type, and fallback props are valid protocolProps of the target. Declared, not exercised: M4's fuzz rows measure the rendered fallback. The row carries its coverage of the components.

metrics.metric: Core components pass automated accessibility checks
metrics.check: axe-coverage > every registered component has a passing axe assertion
metrics.why: 268 axe assertions pass across 48 suites, but Checkbox has NO test file, so coverage is not 100% and a per-test name match cannot detect a missing suite. Needs a coverage check driven by the registry.
metrics.gateWhy: Not measurable in CI yet; becomes hard when its check produces a result.

metrics.metric: Contrast meets WCAG AA
Keyboard navigation works for every interactive component
metrics.why: Per-component suites test keyboard behaviour ad hoc; nothing asserts coverage across all interactive components.
metrics.gateWhy: Not measurable in CI yet; becomes hard when its check produces a result.

metrics.metric: Focus states are visible
metrics.why: code.a11y only flags `outline: none` without `focus` on the same line; that does not prove a visible focus state. Needs a real check.
metrics.gateWhy: Not measurable in CI yet; becomes hard when its check produces a result.

metrics.metric: Form errors are associated with their fields
metrics.why: Real, passing suite: aria-describedby points at the error, the error replaces the help text, and the icon is hidden from assistive tech. Field is the wiring contract every Atlas form uses.

metrics.metric: Reduced-motion behavior is supported
metrics.why: Phase 2d: every component CSS file using --atlas-duration-* has a prefers-reduced-motion block (file-level).

metrics.metric: Token-name drift
metrics.why: Over the whole Figma variable table (atlas/tokens.json figmaTable): a variable whose codeSyntax.WEB is not a var(--atlas-*) reference, or names an undeclared token while its slash-to-dash name is declared. The bound subset (figmaBound) is a cross-check, not the metric.

metrics.metric: Missing code tokens
metrics.why: A Figma variable whose codeSyntax.WEB names a token atlas.tokens.css does not declare. Variables with no codeSyntax.WEB and no CSS token are Figma-only (figmaTable.unpublished) and not counted.
metrics.gateWhy: Open owner decision (DISC-106): two Figma Card hover variables have no code token.

metrics.metric: Missing Figma tokens
metrics.why: A token declared in atlas.tokens.css that no Figma variable's codeSyntax.WEB names and that is not a mode spelled out from one (columns-mobile from the Layout collection's Mobile mode).
metrics.gateWhy: Open owner decision (DISC-107): 15 code tokens have no Figma variable.

metrics.metric: All supported brand modes compile successfully
Critical visual regression tests pass for every brand mode
No raw design values in component implementations
metrics.why: Same as the Catalog Over Code row: colour is enforced, length literals are not.

metrics.metric: No component renders without a valid schema
No unsupported component can reach the renderer
metrics.check: runtime/validator > unknown type replaced by fallback

metrics.metric: Loading, empty, error, active and disabled states exist for all interactive components
metrics.why: Measured from the committed registry by scripts/lib/registry-metrics.mjs (atlas-verify design/registry-states). It checks that every State member Figma draws for an interactive registered type is classified (interaction or prop) and every prop-driven state names a real prop. It does not yet require all five named states per component: which states apply to which component is an owner decision not yet taken. The row carries its coverage of the components.

metrics.metric: No horizontal overflow at supported breakpoints
metrics.check: visual > no horizontal scroll at each breakpoint
